```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Rendering functions — no need to edit below this line
# -------------------------------------------------------
make_service_card <- function(title, date, description, link = "") {
  inner <- paste0(
    '<div class="card-top">',
      '<span class="card-title">', title, '</span>',
      '<span class="card-date">', date, '</span>',
    '</div>',
    '<p class="card-body">', description, '</p>'
  )

  if (!is.na(link) && link != "") {
    paste0('<a href="', link, '" target="_blank" class="service-card">', inner, '</a>')
  } else {
    paste0('<div class="service-card">', inner, '</div>')
  }
}

make_service_section <- function(section_name, df) {
  cards <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    make_service_card(df$title[i], df$date[i], df$description[i], df$link[i])
  }, character(1))

  paste0(
    '<div class="service-section">',
      '<div class="service-section-header">',
        '<span class="section-icon">&#9670;</span>',
        '<h2>', section_name, '</h2>',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="service-grid">',
        paste(cards, collapse = "\n"),
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

cat('<div class="service-intro"><p>I am committed to service that connects statistics with context in other fields and communities, and supports the development of new statisticians and faculty. Below are some of the roles I am currently engaged in, which I include here with the hopes of connecting with others that have similar interests. Please reference my CV for other service roles. </p></div>\n\n')

for (s in unique(service$section)) {
  cat(make_service_section(s, service[service$section == s, ]))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
